column1: # The physics fixtures the service simulates, one row per profile. A request
# names a profile_id and a step count and nothing else the simulation reads:
# the scene, the timestep, the gravity, and the GPU flags belong to the row,
# so a caller chooses among fixtures and supplies no geometry, native code,
# path, or PhysX or CUDA flag. The service validates the ledger whole before it
# answers a request, the way image-profiles.tsv is read.
# profile_id      the name a request carries
# scene           the fixture the runtime builds; the runtime refuses a name it
#                 does not carry
# timestep_s      fixed simulation timestep
# max_steps       the ceiling a request's steps is bounded by
# gravity_y       gravity along -Y in m/s^2, as a positive magnitude
# gpu_dynamics    yes requires eENABLE_GPU_DYNAMICS and refuses the job when the
#                 runtime reports it inactive
# gpu_broadphase  yes requires PxBroadPhaseType::eGPU
# timeout_s       the service's deadline for one job
# execution_policy refused or validator-gated, the same reading the web and
#                 image ledgers give the field: refused emits no tool
# device_index    the CUDA device the runtime binds
# profile_id
physics-d6-chain-a
